title: Why Sanitary Tees Fail on Horizontal Drain Lines
description: Using a standard sanitary tee to connect horizontal drain lines is a critical mistake in drainage systems. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for transitioning from horizontal to vertical flow. When used horizontally, the short sweep fails to direct waste smoothly down the line, leading to frequent blockages, solids buildup, and restricted airflow. To maintain proper flow velocity and prevent clogs, plumbing codes require a combination wye and 1/8 bend or a long-turn tee-wye for horizontal-to-horizontal drainage connections. Always check your local plumbing code for approved fitting directional sweeps.
